formal.scoring: Correct verdicts require a replayed model or an independent UNSAT decision on the identical input hash; unresolved results receive PAR-2 penalty.

supplementary_certificate.boundary: Independent truth evidence only; timed observations unchanged.

record.selected_values: Every original symbol is nullary Int/Bool with a checked ground literal; no selected value depends on ignored model-private syntax.
record.boundary: Supplementary truth on the same original input hash. All original assertions retained. Timed solver verdicts, get-model limitations, resource budgets and observations are unchanged.

diagnostic.boundary: Instrumented, excluded from all formal performance scores.

implementation: Shared NIA/NRA exact sign closure derives necessary nonzero supports, guarded factor cancellation, strict affine bounds, exact fixed-value substitution, and affine polynomial identities. A conflict contains only original SAT reasons. Zero cases and strict endpoints are retained. The bounded local pass has no persistent state, external oracle or runtime feature gate.
boundary: One fixed160 timed round, every original row and model limitation retained. Supplementary truth is separately checked against the identical original input hash. No protected input or QCP whole-program timing is used.

new_independent_truth.evidence: The same-round exported ground model is independently SAT in cvc5 in 0.516245s, within the unchanged60s/16GiB budget. Earlier rounds left this SAT unconfirmed. This evidence improves only the Z3 verified score, not Xolver coverage.
